title: LLMs as Acquisition Policies for Finite-Pool Materials Optimization: A Controlled Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.19790v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Discovering materials with desirable properties often requires searching large candidate spaces while experimental or computational evaluations remain costly. Active learning addresses this challenge by using previous observations to select which candidate to evaluate next, typically through probabilistic surrogate models. We investigate whether open-weight large language models (LLMs) can serve as standalone acquisition policies in this setting. We evaluate five LLMs across four retrospective finite-pool materials optimization tasks under different candidate-presentation strategies and compare them with random selection and conventional Gaussian-process methods. LLM policies generally reach the global optimum in fewer iterations than random selection, indicating that they provide a useful acquisition signal without task-specific training. translated_title: 大型语言模型作为有限池材料优化中的采集策略：一项受控研究
translated_abstract: 摘要：发现具有理想性能的材料通常需要搜索庞大的候选空间，而实验或计算评估成本高昂。主动学习通过利用先前的观察结果来选择下一个评估的候选对象，通常借助概率代理模型来应对这一挑战。我们研究了开放权重的大型语言模型（LLMs）是否能在这一设置中作为独立的采集策略。我们评估了五种LLMs在四种回顾性有限池材料优化任务中的表现，采用不同的候选呈现策略，并将它们与随机选择和传统高斯过程方法进行比较。LLM策略通常能在比随机选择更少的迭代次数内达到全局最优，表明它们无需特定任务训练即可提供有用的采集信号。它们相对于高斯过程方法的性能表现不一：传统采集方法表现更优或更差，取决于具体任务和设置。
tldr: 本研究通过受控实验发现，大型语言模型能作为独立的材料优化采集策略，在无需任务特定训练的情况下比随机选择更高效，但与高斯过程方法相比性能优劣因任务而异。
en_tdlr: This controlled study shows that large language models can serve as standalone acquisition policies for materials optimization, outperforming random selection without task-specific training, though their performance relative to Gaussian-process methods varies by task.
